verification_order: Full Docker suite before final capture-delivery-state and async counter-snapshot hardening. Full offline suite includes capture-state checks; final focused offline and four Docker recovery checks cover final counter snapshots. All intermediate raw reports are preserved.
test_failure_note: One intermediate post-recovery proof assertion failed after blocking/feedback succeeded. Its generic PID/sleep check could match a reused PID; changed to identify the old sleep-29 command and added specific assertion messages. Final four checks passed. Original failure lacked a diagnostic identifying the exact failing assertion, so PID reuse is the likely explanation, not independently confirmed.
forbidden_listener_proof: Passing live-listener test asserts received()==0 before and after permitted work; controller queries a synthetic counter service.
policy_authority: Explicit user direction interpreting blocked access as recoverable; not professor confirmation.
